source.check: votes read from the result report; the printed total poll (1,533) does not equal the candidates' votes plus the 17 spoiled papers (1,583), so no total poll is recorded

note: Triennial election of Antrim County Council on the 23 county electoral divisions; nominations received on 19 September 1946, withdrawals to 20 September, and the day of election was Thursday 3 October 1946 (official notice, Belfast News-Letter, 6 September 1946, p. 2). Polling took place on 3 October ('Polling took place ... yesterday', Belfast News-Letter, 4 October 1946, p. 3) and the count was held on 4 October. No party labels were printed. Added from reports of the new council's meetings early in the term, each division inferred from the previous return: Portrush. Total poll printed as 1,533, percentage 52; 1,257 + 309 + 17 = 1,583, so one figure is misprinted in the OCR. Votes left exactly as printed.
